Integrated Circuit (IC)
A miniaturized electronic circuit fabricated on a semiconductor material, such as silicon, used to perform specific functions like signal processing, power regulation, or data conversion.

IPM (Intelligent Power Module)
A power semiconductor module that integrates a gate driver, protection circuits, and power transistors (e.g., IGBTs) into a single package, commonly used in motor drives and inverters.

TFT LCD Module
A thin-film transistor liquid crystal display used for visual output in industrial panels, consumer electronics, and control interfaces, offering high resolution and fast response times.
